messages.author: a91fabdbaa0d03e2
messages.subject: Stan simulation running extremely slow
parts:
After adding the following line to my Stan model, the simulation runs extremely slow:

to_vector(beta_v) ~ normal(to_vector(beta_t), sigma_beta_v);

where the parameters are declared as follows:

matrix[K,J] beta_t;
matrix[K,J] beta_v;
real<lower=0> sigma_beta_t;

Am I using very inefficient code? If so how can I improve on it. If it helps I can paste the entire Stan code. Much thanks for your help :)

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: Stan simulation running extremely slow
parts:
Hi Michael,

Ben is answering your direct question: "Am I using very inefficient code?" The answer is no. The code is fine and it's fast.

What you're really trying to get at is why is inference slow. And the answer is because it "likely needs reparameterizations" or you'll need to think about your model.



Daniel
